lines.text: US boutique investment bank advising semiconductor and deep-tech companies on M&A and capital raising

bullets: **Deal execution:** support five live sell-side and capital-raising mandates across Europe, the US and Asia-Pacific; assemble the confidential information memorandum (CIM), track NDAs and write weekly client status decks.

**Valuation:** value a capital-raising client with precedent transactions, trading comparables and venture-round benchmarks, building the pro-forma dilution grid for its round; prepare the comparables deck for its CEO.
**Due diligence:** map client data rooms against the firm's information request and flag figures that do not tie; translate a client's accounts into USD (IAS 21) and rebuild its revenue by customer.

**Pitches:** build the firm's success-plan pitches for prospective sell-side clients, four presented since October: technology, financials, customers and team, valuation, sector and macro trends, and tiered buyer lists.

**Origination:** research prospective clients and key contacts for the partner's relationship meetings, then organise and attend 16 meetings with founders and CEOs over two days in Munich, with a profile of each company.

**Research:** co-author the firm's edge-AI market report, sent to c.1,000 executives and buyers, on why AI is moving onto devices, AI chip funding, sector M&A and why chipmakers buy software companies.

lines.text: Search fund targeting Italian SMEs facing owner succession

bullets: Screened Italian SMEs in AIDA (Bureau van Dijk) on owner succession, margin and B2B filters, building a list of c.1,340 acquisition targets for the fund's owner outreach.

Built discounted cash flow (DCF) models for the fund's priority targets, with CAPM-based WACC, bear/base/bull cases and sensitivity analysis, plus an IRR back-solve for the growth needed to reach a 20% IRR at a 5.0x entry multiple.

Wrote target one-pagers scoring recurring revenue, customer concentration and key-person risk, including proprietary targets under NDA, and drafted the Investment Committee memorandum on the fund's lead target.
Analysed price-volume-mix (PVM) and margin variances by product and sales channel; contributed to forecasting.

Run a twice-weekly Python pipeline in which Claude (Anthropic) picks S&P 500 stocks to try to beat the index under fixed rules; decisions are hashed (SHA-256) before trading on an Interactive Brokers paper account via API.
